description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order Amended Ex. Gaz. No. 2314/16 Dated 11.01.2023,Item (iii)Person Leaving Sri Lanka by Air Craft from Jaffna International Air port from 25.02.2023 to 24.01.2024 US $ 30
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves a legal/regulatory matter - specifically an amendment to the Finance Act, No. 25 of 2003. It contains an order issued under statutory authority (Section 2(1) of the Finance Act) that modifies a previous gazette notification by substituting a new schedule related to departure fees from Jaffna International Airport. While it mentions Minister Ranil Wickremesinghe by name and title, the core content is about regulatory changes to existing legislation rather than government personnel changes or portfolio assignments, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5).
